lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: I see an itchy red rash on your arms, present for two weeks.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Use hydrocortisone cream one percent twice a day for a week.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Apply it only on the affected skin.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Come back in two weeks if it is not better.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: I started a new soap last month.
